note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after 40cf3cfaec and 4663a5e15e extended checkXFRMStateScopeCapabilities, and after the {partial} reason was corrected to match it. Parent quote, RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "Then match the packet against the inbound selectors identified by the SAD entry to verify that the received packet is appropriate for the SA via which it was received." Tested: "match the packet against the inbound selectors identified by the SAD entry". Gap: "verify that the received packet is appropriate for the SA via which it was received". Boundary producer: internal/component/ike/engine/child.go::installChildDataplane, with child_scope.go::childStateScope and checkXFRMStateScopeCapabilities. The guard now requires bits 0 to 3 and 5 to 7 (0xef: state scope, ICMP quote, fragment context, fragment guard, ICMP reverse, forwarded ICMP map, forwarded ICMP gate), allows only bit 4 beyond them and refuses unknown bits; the corrected reason states that. No tagged unit changed since the 2026-11-19 rejudgement: tunnel and transport SAD-selector tests deliver an in-selector packet and drop source, port and protocol misses at the state selector (XfrmInStateMismatch +1); the boundary SPD units pin direction, exact port and template and refuse an out-of-mask port; the transport state selector is the negotiated pair; bare ESP whole and fragmented is policy-checked on an ESP-in-UDP state. All fixtures are single-pair, so per-SA isolation within a multi-pair or sibling set stays unproven. Kernel boot facts in the reason are observations, not assertions, and earn no credit. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
